visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair wearing a denim shirt stands in a bright indoor kitchen setting. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a wooden countertop where hands are seen inserting three yellow Lipton tea bags into the mouth of a plastic Sprite bottle. A yellow box of Lipton tea is clearly visible in the background background under bright studio-style lighting. (3) The man is shown crouching next to a large stainless steel refrigerator, placing the infused Sprite bottle inside to chill. He uses both hands to secure the green bottle cap over the tea bag strings before shutting the fridge door. (4) A close-up shot shows a brownish, tea-colored liquid being poured from the Sprite bottle into a clear, stemless glass on the wooden table. The man in the denim shirt is then seen drinking the mixture, showing a positive and surprised reaction with a thumbs-up gesture and an 'OMG' facial expression. Subsequent shots show the tea-infused vodka being poured into a glass, followed by a splash of clear soda from a red can and the squeezing of a fresh yellow lemon. (7) Finally, both men stand together in a medium shot, smiling and laughing as they clink their glasses together in a celebratory toast. 'Cheers' text appears in a bubble overlay, and they both look directly at the camera with high energy.
